title: A member's page offers a birthday WhatsApp to a member the automatic wish already reaches
what: On a member's birthday, the WhatsApp button on their page offers 'Birthday' as a ready message with no word that the automatic birthday wish already pops up on that member's phone. Today's birthday row and the AI ideas leave such members out, so the owner sees '0 birthdays to wish' on Today but is invited to wish the same member again from their page. The member gets two wishes.
expected: The member page says the automatic wish already reaches this member (or leaves the birthday message out for them), the same way Today counts it.
how_often: every birthday of a member with the app linked
fix_line: Use the same automatic-wish check on the member page's WhatsApp sheet that Today uses

title: The owner can never see whether a member got the phone pop-up for a diet plan, workout plan, measurement or new challenge
what: Sending a diet plan or workout plan, saving body measurements, or starting a challenge makes the server write a pop-up note for the member's phone. The admin app never reads those notes. Nowhere can the owner see that the pop-up went, to whom, when, or that it did not (no app, pop-ups off, number not matched, or more than 6 hours late). The notes are deleted after 30 days, so even support cannot answer 'did Asha get it?' later.
expected: The member page (or the plan's list of members) shows for each pop-up: sent at what time, or not sent and why.
how_often: every diet plan, workout plan, measurement and challenge
fix_line: Show the owner a sent or not-sent line, with the reason, for each member pop-up

title: Calling or WhatsApping an enquiry from its row leaves it on 'call today' and in the bell
what: On Enquiries the Call and WhatsApp buttons only open the phone or WhatsApp. Nothing is saved. The enquiry stays in 'To call today', its bell alert stays waiting, and the summary push can still count it, until someone also moves its follow-up date by hand. A second staff member sees it as not called and calls again.
expected: After a call or WhatsApp from the row, the app asks for the next call-back day (or marks it called today), so the list, the bell and the summary push all treat it as done for today.
fix_line: After Call or WhatsApp, ask for the next call-back day in one tap

title: A member who stopped coming is offered a 'we miss you' message again in every place, with no sign anyone already sent one
what: The Losing the habit list on Visits, the same list on Today, the member page's 'Haven't seen you' message and the Messages group for members who stopped coming all point at the same people. Tapping Message saves nothing. Every place, every staff member and every day shows the same member as still needing a word, so a member can get the same nudge from the owner, the desk and a group message.
expected: Sending the nudge from any place marks the member as 'messaged on <day>' on the server, and every other list shows that.
fix_line: Keep a server 'messaged on' mark and show it on every stopped-coming list

title: Free days given by hand for a friend who joined still leave 'Give free days' on the enquiry
what: If the owner thanks the inviting member by adding extra days from that member's page, the enquiry never learns it. It knows only its own tap, or a plan note written in its exact words. 'Give free days' stays on the friend's row, and a second person can give the days again.
expected: The enquiry sees extra days already added to the inviting member since the friend joined and asks before giving more.
how_often: when the thank-you is given from the member page
fix_line: Warn on 'Give free days' when the member got extra days after the friend joined
